title: ZeroTier
summary: Manage your ZeroTier networks from the CardputerZero keyboard
description:
ZeroTier for the CardputerZero shows the node and its networks (status and managed IP) and lets you join a network by its 16-digit ID, connect, disconnect (the network stays joined) or leave it, all from the keyboard.

The app is a front end for the zerotier-one service. At the first start it offers to set everything up: it adds the official ZeroTier apt repository (download.zerotier.com), installs zerotier-one, starts it and copies the service token to your home folder (mode 600). You type your sudo password on the device keyboard; it is never stored or logged. No sudoers rule and no zerotier-cli process: the app talks to the local service API (127.0.0.1:9993).

The list refreshes every 5 seconds. Interface in French, English, Japanese and Simplified Chinese (F2). Statically linked Rust build.
